goal: Exercise the Pass Orchestrator independent audit gate with two harmless documentation-only sub-passes, pausing after each checkpoint until an external GitHub comment ledger entry approves the exact commit SHA.
global_constraints: Only add Markdown files under docs/.
Never touch the main branch; all work happens on pass_branch only.
Never commit unrelated or accidental files (build output, .vs/, bin/, obj/).

sub_passes.title: Add audit gate notes
sub_passes.objective: Create docs/audit-gate-notes.md with a short explanation of the audit ledger concept.
acceptance_criteria: It explains that the audit ledger gates continuation by exact checkpoint SHA.
No other file is modified by this sub-pass.

sub_passes.title: Add audit resume notes
sub_passes.objective: Create docs/audit-resume-notes.md describing how resume checks the ledger before continuing.
acceptance_criteria: It states that a matching APPROVED ledger entry is required before the next sub-pass.
No other file is modified by this sub-pass.

requirements: Exactly two checkpoint commits exist on pass_branch beyond base_branch, one per sub-pass, in order.
The cumulative diff from base_branch to HEAD touches only: docs/audit-gate-notes.md and docs/audit-resume-notes.md.
StudentPlannerApp/**, StudentPlannerApp.sln, and .github/workflows/** are byte-for-byte unchanged versus base_branch.
Each completed sub-pass has an AUDIT_APPROVED GitHub comment ledger entry matching its exact checkpoint SHA.
main was never checked out for writes and was never pushed to.
No force-push occurred at any point.
